messages:
Clare (CS): Quick sync 1: Orion is approved for dedicated capacity bring-up next Tue. Main asks: quota, autoscale policy, and a short smoke.
Devon (SRE): Ok. Do we have their expected steady QPS and burst pattern?
Clare (CS): They committed 1.2k steady QPS and occasional promos with ~3.6k bursts for ~10min.
Sam (PM): My recommendation: reserve 2 warm GPUs for first 48h, enable KV prefix priming, and run a canary spike before cutover.
Devon (SRE): I'll prep a reserved pool. Draft scale policy below 1:
```json
{"scale_policy":"min_nodes:2,max_nodes:10,step:1,cooldown:60s","cpu_target":"65%","gpu_margin":"20%"}
```
Clare (CS): Maya, please confirm this policy envelope is ok for Orion.
Maya (Customer): That looks fine. Can you run a brief smoke on Mon night (low-traffic) to validate priming and routing?
Sam (PM): Mon 02:00-03:00 PT works for the team. We'll do a controlled spike and target P95 < 200ms.
Devon (SRE): Proposed load command:
```bash
rload --target https://dedicated.redwood.test/orion --profile spike --qps 1200 --burst 3600 --duration 15m --threads 60
```
Devon (SRE): We'll stream smoke logs to /var/log/redwood/orion-smoke and attach traces. opsbot will post start/finish.
opsbot: Scheduled job 3479994321-smoke at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z.
Clare (CS): Sam, can you share top 20 prefixes from Orion's test set so we can prime KV cache? Use secure link.
Sam (PM): Sending link in 5m. Use small batch sizes for priming to fill caches fast.
Devon (SRE): Fallback plan: prefer dedicated, but route to hosted-lite if tail latency >1s for >2min. Add alert: orion.dedicated.tail_latency_fallback to CS on-call and customer. Agreed?
Clare (CS): Agreed. I'll add the alert and notify the on-call.
Maya (Customer): Please also provide a short readiness checklist and rollback steps for our infra team.
Clare (CS): I'll produce a one-page runbook with timeline, rollback, contacts, and smoke thresholds (ETA Mon 16:00 PT).
Devon (SRE): Action items:
- Devon: provision reserved pool and apply scale_policy (ETA Mon 10:00 PT)
- Sam: share prefix list (ETA in 10m)
- Clare: write 1-page runbook (ETA Mon 16:00 PT)
- Maya: confirm engineers on-call for Mon smoke (confirm now)
Maya (Customer): Confirmed 1 we will have two engineers on the smoke window.
opsbot: Job 3479994321-smoke completed at 2026-03-23T02:18:00Z 1 peak QPS 3600, P95 180ms, error rate 0.6%
Devon (SRE): Infra looks stable. We'll proceed to full warmup tomorrow night and target Tue 11:00 PT for cutover.
Clare (CS): Tentative go-live Tue 11:00 PT. Closing this coordination thread unless blockers arise. :thumbsup:
